phase: exploratory correction and patient-level program refinement
trigger: User supplied review and authorized selective corrections
pairing_rule: Only exact source-ID pairs; no recovery based on expression
primary_axis: Association of paired transcript change with week6 clinical response, adjusted for randomized arm; newly registered exploratory axis
secondary_axis: GLM minus Placebo change with CI; within-arm and interaction effects; no equivalence claim
pathway_branches: fry directional and mixed self-contained null
pathway_scope: 50 Hallmark; full prior GO remains supplementary exploratory, no count interpreted as discoveries
patient_scores: Unweighted gene-wise mean log2 expression, delta post-baseline. Baseline mean differences do not affect paired delta.
candidate_definition: Six review-proposed genes AQP8 HMGCS2 GUCA2A CA2 SLC26A3 MS4A12, explicitly post hoc; reference programs added from verified literature without using external expression
confidence_intervals: Within-arm one-sample t CI, between-arm Welch CI; patient-level adjusted models OLS t CI
response_model_sensitivity: arm + response + baseline program score + baseline total Mayo
clinical response association adjusting inflammation and epithelial abundance proxy; not causal
multiplicity: BH per declared contrast and family, additional combined contrast BH; full results retained
